description: 25x10 grid invariant check on kala_field_null (25 event classes x 10 duration buckets), both charts
reproduce_cmd: SELECT chart_id, count(*) as n, count(DISTINCT event_class) as n_classes, count(DISTINCT bucket_days) as n_buckets, array_agg(DISTINCT bucket_days ORDER BY bucket_days) as buckets FROM kala_field_null GROUP BY chart_id;
verdict_native: PASS -- exactly 250 = 25 x 10 rows, matching kala_field_snapshots.event_classes' declared 25-class list for this chart exactly (no skipped classes for the native chart's snapshot).
verdict_second_chart: The 6x10=60 grid is internally consistent (matches the 6 event classes that actually have kala_field rows for this chart), but kala_field_snapshots.event_classes for this chart declares 27 classes, 21 of which are recorded in skipped_classes with reason 'no_class_prior_row'. See finding on event_classes/skipped_classes field semantics.
